turns.text: Hello. I want to return order SC-5216. The email is thymele.jderescu@example.com.

Thank you, Thymele. I checked order SC-5216 (Nurca de indigo, 30x40 cm). It is shipped but not yet delivered, and our policy only allows returns within 14 days of delivery, so I can't file a return for it right now. Once the order is delivered, you can ask again within 14 days of delivery. Please note that the customer pays the return postage, and staff must approve any refund. You can follow the parcel with this link: https://curier.example/track/SC5216

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

error.message: The order has not been delivered yet.

turns.text: The parcel has not reached me yet. I changed my mind.

I understand the parcel has not reached you yet. I checked whether order SC-5216 can be cancelled instead. Our policy allows cancellation only while the order is paid and production has not started. For this order, production has already started, so I can't file a cancellation. A return is also not possible until the order is delivered, and then only within 14 days of delivery, with the customer paying return postage. Staff must approve any refund. If you want to talk to a colleague about this order, I can pass the conversation on.

rule.ro: O comandă se poate anula cât timp este plătită și producția nu a început. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: An order can be cancelled while it is paid and production has not started. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: Also, can you help me fill in my tax return for last year? It has nothing to do with the shop, but I am stuck on the form.

Sorry, I can't help with tax returns or other questions that are not about Studio Cobalt. For help with your tax form, please contact a tax adviser or your tax authority. I can still help with your order SC-5216 if you have other questions about it.
Back to the order. Please file the shop return. I am not threatening anyone.

I understand, and I'm not assuming you are threatening anyone. I checked again, and the answer is the same. Order SC-5216 has not been delivered yet. Our policy allows returns only within 14 days of delivery, so I can't file a return for it now. I can't file it just because you ask, and I won't try again with other details. Once the order is delivered, you can contact us again within 14 days of delivery. If you would like a colleague to review your case, I can pass the conversation on to them.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
